# K locus annotations - reported in main text

#### Load data
```{r}
kosc_summary <- read_csv("KoSC_K_functional_reannotated.csv") # output from gene clustering and HMM searches
```

## Count unique GTs
```{r}
kosc_summary %>%
  filter(Is_Glycosyl_transferase == TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_GTRs = n(),
    distinct_CC = n_distinct(CC),
  )
```
## GT per locus counts
```{r}
kosc_summary %>%
  filter(Is_Glycosyl_transferase %in% c("TRUE")) %>%
  group_by(Locus) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Locus = paste(unique(Locus), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Count _wbaP_ 'PRK15204.1' / _wcaJ_ 'PRK10124.1'
```{r}
kosc_summary %>% filter(PGAP_Best %in% c('PRK15204.1', 'PRK10124.1')) %>%
  count(PGAP_Best)
```

## Total number of unique loci with _wzy_ annotated
```{r}
kosc_summary %>%
  filter(Wzy_Best %in% c("WzyA","WzyB","WzyC")) %>%
  summarise(n_loci = n_distinct(Locus))
```

## Total number of loci with _wzx_ annotated
```{r}
kosc_summary %>%
  filter(Gene_name %in% c("wzx")) %>%
  summarise(total = n())
```

# Typing stats - reported in main text


#### Load data
```{r label, options}
tableS3 <- read_excel("Supplementary_Tables.xlsx", sheet = "Supp_Table3")
```

## Final dataset

#### Count total genomes in final dataset
```{r}
tableS3 %>% group_by(`Included in final dataset? (yes/no)`) %>% summarise(n=n())

# note NA represets rare species which did not have qualibact QC thresholds, but passed based on empiric criteria
```

#### Filter to final dataset
```{r}
tableS3 %>% filter(`Included in final dataset? (yes/no)` == "yes") -> final_dataset
```


#### Typing rate KoSC DB for final dataset

```{r}
final_dataset %>% group_by(KoSC_match_confidence) %>% summarise(n=n())
```

#### Typing rate by genome source
```{r}
final_dataset %>% filter(Genome_source != "In house") %>% group_by(Genome_source, KoSC_match_confidence) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% dcast(Genome_source ~ KoSC_match_confidence) -> contigency_table
```

```{r}
contigency_table %>% mutate(rate = (Typeable / (Typeable + Untypeable)*100))
```

#### pairwise prop test
```{r}
as.matrix(contigency_table[2:3])
pairwise.prop.test(as.matrix(contigency_table[2:3]), p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```

#### Supplementary Figure 6 - assembly metrics by source and species

##### No Contigs
```{r, fig.width = 12}
final_dataset %>% filter(Species %in% c("K. oxytoca", "K. michiganensis", "K. pasteurii", "K. grimontii")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x= Genome_source, y = `No. Contigs`, fill = Genome_source)) + geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("NCBI RefSeq", "NCBI GenBank", "AllTheBacteria", "Pathogenwatch"), labels = c("RS", "GB", "ATB", "PW")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 500, 50)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#b2df8a", "#a6cee3", "#1f78b4", "#fb9a99")) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + guides(fill=FALSE) +
  xlab("Genome Source") +
  facet_wrap(. ~ Species, nrow=1) -> plot_n_contigs
```

##### Genome Length
```{r, fig.width = 12}
final_dataset %>% filter(Species %in% c("K. oxytoca", "K. michiganensis", "K. pasteurii", "K. grimontii")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x= Genome_source, y = `Genome Length`, fill = Genome_source)) + geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("NCBI RefSeq", "NCBI GenBank", "AllTheBacteria", "Pathogenwatch")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 7000000, 250000), labels = seq(0, 7, 0.25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#b2df8a", "#a6cee3", "#1f78b4", "#fb9a99")) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill=FALSE) +
  ylab("Genome Length (Mbp)") +
  facet_wrap(. ~ Species, nrow=1) -> plot_genome_length
```

##### N50
```{r, fig.width = 12}
final_dataset %>% filter(Species %in% c("K. oxytoca", "K. michiganensis", "K. pasteurii", "K. grimontii")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x= Genome_source, y = N50, fill = Genome_source)) + geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("NCBI RefSeq", "NCBI GenBank", "AllTheBacteria", "Pathogenwatch")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 7000000, 1000000), labels = seq(0, 7, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#b2df8a", "#a6cee3", "#1f78b4", "#fb9a99")) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill=FALSE) +
  ylab("N50 (Mbp)") +
  facet_wrap(. ~ Species, nrow=1) -> plot_N50
```

##### Combined figure - Supp Figure 7
```{r assembly_metrics_plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
plot_N50 + plot_genome_length + plot_n_contigs + plot_layout(nrow = 3)
```
*Note for the published version of the figure, sample sizes as calculated below were manually added to X-axis labels using Adobe Illustrator.*

# Typing stats - reported in supplementary text

#### Get match quality info for KoSC db typeables
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>% filter(KoSC_match_confidence == "Typeable") %>% group_by(KoSC_match_problems) %>% summarise(n=n())
```

#### Get match quality info for Kp db typeables
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>% filter(Kp_match_confidence == "Typeable") %>% group_by(Kp_match_problems) %>% summarise(n=n())
```

#### Format KoSC matches for stats comparison
*remove % characters for ID and cov*
*turn into long table with a column labelling by DB*
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>% mutate(KoSC_match_id = (str_remove_all(KoSC_match_id, "%")), KoSC_match_cov = (str_remove_all(KoSC_match_cov, "%"))) %>% select(KoSC_match_confidence, KoSC_match_id, KoSC_match_cov) %>% mutate(database = "KoSC") %>% rename(id = KoSC_match_id, cov = KoSC_match_cov, confidence = KoSC_match_confidence) -> match_comparison
```

#### Format Kp matches for stats comparison
*remove % characters for ID and cov*
*turn into long table with a column labelling by DB and bind to above*
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>% mutate(Kp_match_id = (str_remove_all(Kp_match_id, "%")), Kp_match_cov = (str_remove_all(Kp_match_cov, "%"))) %>% select(Kp_match_confidence, Kp_match_id, Kp_match_cov) %>% mutate(database = "Kp") %>% rename(id = Kp_match_id, cov = Kp_match_cov, confidence = Kp_match_confidence) %>% rbind(., match_comparison) -> match_comparison
```


#### Calculate stats for coverage using Wilcox
```{r}
match_comparison %>% filter (confidence == "Typeable") %>% mutate(cov = as.numeric(cov)) %>%  wilcox.test(cov ~ database, data = .)
```

#### Calculate stats for identity using Wilcox
```{r}
match_comparison %>% filter (confidence == "Typeable") %>% mutate(id = as.numeric(id)) %>%  wilcox.test(id ~ database, data = .)
```
#### Print average coverage / identity of 'Typeable' genomes
```{r}
match_comparison %>%
  filter(confidence == "Typeable") %>%
  mutate(
    cov   = as.numeric(cov),
    id = as.numeric(id)
  ) %>%
  group_by(database) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_cov = (median(cov, na.rm = TRUE))*100,
    median_id = (median(id, na.rm = TRUE))*100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

#### Comparing Kp and KoSC results for orthologous loci
*Mark those that are typable with Kp db where the Best match type does not match the KoSC type and is not a direct or similar ortholog as per ortholog list*
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>% mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(Kp_match_confidence == "Typeable" & (Kp_best_match_K_locus != KoSC_best_match_K_locus), "mismatch", "ok"))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL152" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL10", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL102" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL11", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL181" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL19", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL186" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL23", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL109" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL14", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL47" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL30", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL43" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL6", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL164" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL57", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL68" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL83", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL26" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL9", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL145" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL4", "ok", mismatch_types))) %>%
  mutate(mismatch_types = (if_else(mismatch_types == "mismatch" & Kp_best_match_K_locus == "KL174" & KoSC_best_match_K_locus == "KL3", "ok", mismatch_types))) -> nonredundant_dataset
```


#### Supplementary Figure 7
```{r Supp_fig_3, fig.width = 5, fig.height=4}
nonredundant_dataset %>%
  filter(mismatch_types == "mismatch") %>%
  mutate(
    KoSC_id = str_remove_all(KoSC_match_id, "%"),
    Kp_id = str_remove_all(Kp_match_id, "%"),
    KoSC_cov = str_remove_all(KoSC_match_cov, "%"),
    Kp_cov = str_remove_all(Kp_match_cov, "%"),
    id_diff = (as.numeric(KoSC_match_id) - as.numeric(Kp_match_id))*100,
    cov_diff = (as.numeric(KoSC_match_cov) - as.numeric(Kp_match_cov))*100,
    extra_genes_diff = KoSC_other_gene_count - Kp_other_genes_count
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cov_diff, y = extra_genes_diff)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, 50), ylim = c(-4, 3)) +
  ylab("Extra genes difference") +
  xlab("Coverage difference")
```


# Look at the minority of cases where there is a mismatch and greater coverage of the Kp locus and/or greater number of extra genes reported for the KoSC locus
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>% filter(mismatch_types == "mismatch") %>% mutate(KoSC_match_id = (str_remove_all(KoSC_match_id, "%")), Kp_match_id = (str_remove_all(Kp_match_id, "%")), KoSC_match_cov = (str_remove_all(KoSC_match_cov, "%")), Kp_match_cov = (str_remove_all(Kp_match_cov, "%"))) %>% mutate(id_diff = as.numeric(KoSC_match_id)-as.numeric(Kp_match_id), cov_diff = as.numeric(KoSC_match_cov)-as.numeric(Kp_match_cov), extra_genes_diff = KoSC_other_gene_count-Kp_other_genes_count) %>% filter(cov_diff < 0 | extra_genes_diff > 0) %>% arrange(Kp_length_discrepency)
```


# Figure 2 - rarefaction curves by species

#### Counts by K locus and species for four most common species
```{r}
nonredundant_dataset %>%
  filter(
    KoSC_match_confidence == "Typeable",
    Species %in% c("K. michiganensis","K. oxytoca","K. pasteurii","K. grimontii")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species, KoSC_best_match_K_locus) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = KoSC_best_match_K_locus, values_from = n) %>%
  as.data.frame() -> K_nums_by_species
```

#### Change rownames to col 1
```{r}
rownames(K_nums_by_species) <- K_nums_by_species$Species
```

#### Convert NA to 0
```{r}
K_nums_by_species[is.na(K_nums_by_species)] <- 0 
```

#### Plot Figure 1
```{r FigY, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
rarecurve(K_nums_by_species[2:ncol(K_nums_by_species)], tidy = TRUE) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y=Species, colour = Site)) + geom_point(size=0.1) + geom_line() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1, angle = 45)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 4600, 200)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 90, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual("Species", values = c("#177E89", "#FFBC42", "#DB3A34", "#000100")) +
  ylab("Cumulative number of K loci") + xlab("Number of genomes")
```
*Note: For the manuscript version of the figure, the legend was removed and species labels added next to curves using Adobe Illustrator*

# Sero-epi use case - reported in main text

#### Load data
```{r}
sero_epi <- read_excel("Supplementary_Tables.xlsx", sheet = "Supp_Table4")
```


#### Check genome counts by study
```{r}
sero_epi %>% group_by(Dataset) %>% summarise(n=n())
```

#### Get species by Dataset
```{r}
sero_epi %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Species) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = n)
```

#### Count total STs represented
```{r}
sero_epi %>% group_by(ST) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% nrow()
```


#### Get counts for unique STs and KLs by study
```{r}
sero_epi %>% group_by(Dataset) %>% summarise(n_KL = n_distinct(`KoSC KL`), n_ST = n_distinct(ST))
```


#### Check KL counts overall
```{r}
sero_epi %>% group_by(`KoSC KL`) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% arrange(-n)
```

#### Get KL counts by study
```{r}
sero_epi %>%
  group_by(`KoSC KL`, Dataset) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = n)
```
* List of KLs that account for at least 5 isolates in each collection: "KL74", "KL34", "KL6", "KL69", "KL83", "KL86", "KL29", "KL76", "KL49", "KL71"*

#### Define list of top KLs for all studies (n>=5 in at least one study) 
```{r }
topK <- c("KL74", "KL34", "KL6", "KL69", "KL83", "KL86", "KL29", "KL76", "KL49", "KL71")
```

#### Mark top KL vs other in datasheet
```{r}
sero_epi %>% mutate(topK = if_else(`KoSC KL` %in% topK, `KoSC KL`, "other")) -> sero_epi
```


#### Get ST counts by study
```{r}
sero_epi %>%
  group_by(ST, Dataset) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Dataset, values_from = n)
```

#### Define list of top STs for all studies (n>=5 in at least one study) 
```{r }
topSTs <- c("ST266", "ST178", "ST176", "ST43", "ST199", "ST40", "ST19", "ST18", "ST258", "ST11", "ST179", "ST482", "ST85", "ST88", "ST36", "ST199-1LV")
```

#### Mark top ST vs other in datasheet
```{r}
sero_epi %>% mutate(topST = if_else(ST %in% topSTs, ST, "other")) -> sero_epi
```


# Figure 4 - sero-epi use case

#### Make plot of K locus counts by study
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
#### Make plot of K counts by study
sero_epi %>% ggplot(aes(x = topK, fill = Dataset)) + geom_bar() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits= rev(c(topK, "other"))) +
  xlab("K loci") + ylab("Number of genomes") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00A5CF", "#5C2751", "#EE4266")) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Dataset) + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "A",
     fill = "Dataset"
     ) -> KL_by_study_plot
```

```{r}
KL_by_study_plot <- KL_by_study_plot +
  labs(title = "A") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0)
  )
```


#### Make plot K locus by ST
```{r}
sero_epi %>% ggplot(aes(x=topST, y=topK, colour = Dataset)) + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0.25, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(c(topK, "other"))) + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c(topSTs, "other")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#00A5CF", "#5C2751", "#EE4266")) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, angle = 45), legend.position = "none", axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  xlab("7-gene ST") +
   labs(
     title = "B",
     colour = "Dataset"
     ) -> K_vs_ST_plot
```

# Rare K loci - reported in Supplementary Results

#### Find rare loci
```{r}
final_dataset %>% filter(KoSC_match_confidence == "Typeable") %>% group_by(KoSC_best_match_K_locus) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% filter(n<2) -> rare_loci
```

```{r}
final_dataset %>% filter(KoSC_match_confidence == "Typeable", KoSC_best_match_K_locus %in% rare_loci$KoSC_best_match_K_locus)
```
